# Play Store Submission Guide

## What Files to Upload

### ✅ Required Files (Generated by Android Studio)

1. **Android App Bundle (AAB)** - **PRIMARY FILE**
   - **Location**: `android/app/release/app-release.aab`
   - **Format**: `.aab` (Android App Bundle)
   - **Why**: Google Play requires AAB format (APK is deprecated for new apps)
   - **How to Generate**: See "How to Build Release" below

2. **APK (Optional - for testing)**
   - **Location**: `android/app/release/app-release.apk`
   - **Format**: `.apk`
   - **Why**: Only if you need to test install manually
   - **Note**: Play Store prefers AAB, but APK can be used for internal testing

### ✅ Required Assets for Play Store Listing

#### 1. App Icon
- **Size**: 512x512 pixels
- **Format**: PNG (32-bit with alpha channel)
- **Location**: Replace files in `android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/ic_launcher.png`
- **Required Sizes**:
  - `mipmap-mdpi/ic_launcher.png` (48x48)
  - `mipmap-hdpi/ic_launcher.png` (72x72)
  - `mipmap-xhdpi/ic_launcher.png` (96x96)
  - `mipmap-xxhdpi/ic_launcher.png` (144x144)
  - `mipmap-xxxhdpi/ic_launcher.png` (192x192)
  - `mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml` (adaptive icon for Android 8+)

#### 2. Feature Graphic
- **Size**: 1024x500 pixels
- **Format**: PNG or JPG
- **Purpose**: Banner shown at top of Play Store listing

#### 3. Screenshots
- **Phone Screenshots**: At least 2, up to 8
  - **Size**: 16:9 or 9:16 aspect ratio
  - **Min Resolution**: 320px (shortest side)
  - **Max Resolution**: 3840px (longest side)
- **Tablet Screenshots** (Optional): Same requirements
- **7-inch Tablet**: 1024x600 minimum
- **10-inch Tablet**: 1280x800 minimum

#### 4. App Description
- **Short Description**: 80 characters max
- **Full Description**: 4000 characters max
- **What to Include**:
  - What the app does
  - Key features
  - How to use it

#### 5. Privacy Policy URL (Required if collecting data)
- **Format**: HTTPS URL
- **Content**: Must explain data collection, usage, sharing
- **Note**: Even if not collecting data, recommended to have one

### ✅ Optional Assets

1. **Promotional Video** (YouTube)
   - **Length**: 30 seconds to 2 minutes
   - **Format**: YouTube link

2. **Promotional Graphic**
   - **Size**: 180x120 pixels
   - **Format**: PNG or JPG

3. **Phone Banner** (Optional)
   - **Size**: 1024x500 pixels

## How to Build Release Files

### Step 1: Generate Signed App Bundle (AAB)

1. **Open Android Studio**
   - File → Open → Select `android/` folder

2. **Create Keystore** (First time only)
   ```
   Build → Generate Signed Bundle / APK
   → Select "Android App Bundle"
   → Click "Create new..." under "Key store path"
   → Fill in:
     - Key store path: Choose location (e.g., android/app/release.keystore)
     - Password: Create strong password (SAVE THIS!)
     - Key alias: viharsevagroup
     - Key password: Same or different (SAVE THIS!)
     - Validity: 25 years (recommended)
     - Certificate info: Fill in your details
   → Click OK
   ```

3. **Build Release Bundle**
   ```
   Build → Generate Signed Bundle / APK
   → Select "Android App Bundle"
   → Select your keystore
   → Enter passwords
   → Select "release" build variant
   → Click "Finish"
   ```

4. **Output Location**
   - File will be at: `android/app/release/app-release.aab`

### Step 2: Generate Signed APK (Optional - for testing)

1. **Same process as above**
   ```
   Build → Generate Signed Bundle / APK
   → Select "APK" (instead of Bundle)
   → Follow same steps
   ```

2. **Output Location**
   - File will be at: `android/app/release/app-release.apk`

### Step 3: Test the APK (Before Uploading)

1. **Install on Device**
   ```bash
   adb install app-release.apk
   ```

2. **Test Everything**
   - [ ] App opens correctly
   - [ ] Website loads
   - [ ] Charts render properly
   - [ ] Navigation works
   - [ ] Offline handling works
   - [ ] File upload works (if applicable)
   - [ ] External links open correctly

## What NOT to Upload

### ❌ Do NOT Upload These:

1. **Source Code** (`.kt`, `.java` files)
   - Play Store doesn't need source code
   - Only upload compiled `.aab` or `.apk`

2. **Gradle Files** (`.gradle`, `build/` folder)
   - Not needed for Play Store
   - Only needed for building

3. **Development Files**
   - `.idea/` folder
   - `local.properties`
   - `*.iml` files
   - `gradle/` folder (except wrapper)

4. **Debug Builds**
   - Only upload **release** builds
   - Debug builds are larger and not optimized

5. **Keystore File** (`.keystore`, `.jks`)
   - **NEVER** upload your keystore file
   - Keep it secure and backed up
   - If lost, you cannot update your app

## Play Store Console Upload Process

### Step 1: Create App Listing

1. Go to [Google Play Console](https://play.google.com/console)
2. Click "Create app"
3. Fill in:
   - **App name**: Vihar Seva Group
   - **Default language**: English (or your language)
   - **App or game**: App
   - **Free or paid**: Free
   - **Declarations**: Check all applicable boxes

### Step 2: Upload AAB File

1. Go to **Release** → **Production** (or **Testing**)
2. Click **Create new release**
3. Upload your `app-release.aab` file
4. Fill in **Release name**: `1.0.0` (or your version)
5. Fill in **Release notes**: What's new in this version
6. Click **Save**

### Step 3: Complete Store Listing

1. **App Details**
   - App name
   - Short description (80 chars)
   - Full description (4000 chars)
   - App icon (512x512)
   - Feature graphic (1024x500)
   - Screenshots (at least 2)

2. **Content Rating**
   - Complete questionnaire
   - Get rating certificate

3. **Privacy Policy**
   - Add URL (required if collecting data)
   - Or create simple policy page

4. **Target Audience**
   - Select age groups
   - Select content categories

### Step 4: Review and Submit

1. Check all sections are complete
2. Review app information
3. Click **Submit for review**

## File Checklist Before Submission

### ✅ Build Files
- [ ] `app-release.aab` generated
- [ ] AAB file tested on device
- [ ] Version code and name updated in `build.gradle.kts`
- [ ] Keystore file backed up securely

### ✅ Store Assets
- [ ] App icon (512x512) ready
- [ ] Feature graphic (1024x500) ready
- [ ] At least 2 screenshots ready
- [ ] App description written
- [ ] Short description written (80 chars)

### ✅ App Information
- [ ] App name finalized
- [ ] Privacy policy URL ready (if needed)
- [ ] Content rating completed
- [ ] Target audience selected

### ✅ Testing
- [ ] App tested on multiple devices
- [ ] All features working
- [ ] No crashes or errors
- [ ] Performance is good

## Version Management

### Update Version in `build.gradle.kts`

```kotlin
defaultConfig {
    versionCode = 1  // Increment for each release (1, 2, 3...)
    versionName = "1.0.0"  // User-visible version (1.0.0, 1.0.1, 1.1.0...)
}
```

**Rules:**
- **versionCode**: Must increase with each release (1, 2, 3...)
- **versionName**: Can be any string (1.0.0, 1.0.1, 2.0.0...)

## Important Notes

### 🔒 Security
- **NEVER** share your keystore file
- **NEVER** commit keystore to Git
- **BACKUP** keystore file securely
- If keystore is lost, you cannot update the app

### 📱 Testing
- Test on multiple Android versions
- Test on different screen sizes
- Test offline functionality
- Test all features thoroughly

### ⏱️ Timeline
- First review: Usually 1-3 days
- Updates: Usually faster (hours to 1 day)
- Rejections: Fix issues and resubmit

## Quick Reference

**Files to Upload:**
1. ✅ `app-release.aab` (Primary)
2. ✅ App icon (512x512)
3. ✅ Feature graphic (1024x500)
4. ✅ Screenshots (at least 2)
5. ✅ App description

**Files NOT to Upload:**
1. ❌ Source code
2. ❌ Keystore file
3. ❌ Gradle files
4. ❌ Debug builds

**Where to Upload:**
- **AAB**: Google Play Console → Release → Production
- **Assets**: Google Play Console → Store listing
